words.meaning: To perform or repeat an action, often to improve it.
words.example: We need to iterate on this React component before the hackathon demo tomorrow.

words.meaning: A completely different line of thought or action.
words.example: Professor Sharma went off on a fascinating tangent about AI ethics during our lecture.

words.meaning: To provide evidence to support or prove the truth of.
words.example: Make sure you can substantiate your claims in the marketing pitch deck.

words.meaning: Of crucial importance in relation to the development or success of something.
words.example: Scoring that internship was pivotal for getting my final year project approved.

words.meaning: To be a typical example of something.
words.example: His clean code and documentation completely exemplify best software practices.

words.meaning: An illogical difference between two or more things that should match.
words.example: There is a weird discrepancy in the attendance data sheet from yesterday.
We need to figure out if this startup idea is financially viable in Noida.

words.meaning: Existing or occurring at or on the surface; lacking depth.
words.example: That tutorial gave only a superficial understanding of machine learning models.

words.meaning: Open to more than one interpretation; having a double meaning.
words.example: The instructions for the assignment were too ambiguous for us to start coding.

loop.meaning: A defiant, confident, and unapologetic attitude, popularized by Charli XCX's album aesthetic as messy, high-energy party culture.
loop.example: We are going to be so brat this entire weekend, zero sleep.
loop.context: Used in reels and conversations to describe a chaotic, fun lifestyle. Not rude, just very energetic.

loop.meaning: Keeping someone interested as a backup option by giving them just enough attention without committing to a real relationship.
loop.example: She never makes actual plans with him, she's just benching him.
loop.context: Used in dating discussions on podcasts to describe toxic modern communication habits.

loop.meaning: Fear Of Missing Out, the anxiety that an exciting or interesting event is happening elsewhere right now.
loop.example: I stayed home to study, but the FOMO is killing me after seeing their stories.
loop.context: Casual conversation filler when explaining why you went to a party or bought something you didn't need.

loop.meaning: A meme and insult used jokingly or seriously to mock someone who is financially unstable or cheap on dates.
loop.example: If he doesn't pay for the Uber, he's a broke boy, period.
loop.context: Massive on Indian and global dating reels. Often used ironically among guy friends.

loop.meaning: A tongue exercise meant to define the jawline, turned into a viral meme where people gesture to their jaw instead of answering questions.
loop.example: Bro was asked a serious question in class and just started mewing.
loop.context: Extremely common in school and college reels to shut down awkward conversations.

loop.meaning: The practice of ending all communication with someone suddenly without explanation.
loop.example: We went on three great dates and then she just ghosted me out of nowhere.
loop.context: Universal dating term used across all friend groups and podcasts.

loop.meaning: Financial Independence, Retire Early, a lifestyle movement focused on extreme saving and investing to quit work decades early.
loop.example: He's living on instant noodles because he's obsessed with the FIRE movement.
loop.context: Popular among finance bros and tech podcasts discussing wealth building.

india.text: Delhi's Development Authority has banned single-use plastic bottles at its sports complexes as part of a cleanliness drive.
Karnataka has estimated losses of about 46,000 crore rupees from drought phases and is seeking 7,500 crore rupees from the Centre.
Security agencies in Kashmir have detected the use of advanced off-grid LoRa handsets by Pakistani terror operatives.
Economic experts anticipate the Reserve Bank of India may hike interest rates by 0.25 percent due to persistent inflationary pressures.
Karnataka police arrested seven individuals, including three Pakistan nationals, for alleged terror links and communicating via encrypted apps.
Farmer organizations represented by the Samyukta Kisan Morcha rejected the government's minimum support price hike for wheat as insufficient.
The Supreme Court indicated strict consequences for the parents of a man who allegedly abducted his daughter to the United States.
Punjab police busted a cross-border arms network in Tarn Taran district, recovering an AK-47 rifle and grenades.
The government raised the deepwater natural gas price ceiling to 9.89 US dollars per MMBtu for the period from October 2026.
India's Directorate General of Civil Aviation is conducting final airline audits ahead of the United States aviation safety assessment in November.

world.text: Brazil’s presidential election is heading to an October 25 runoff after right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro outperformed expectations against incumbent President Lula in the first round.
Yemeni government forces announced an all-out military offensive to reclaim territory from Houthi rebels amid intensifying regional conflict.
Pro-government forces in Ethiopia retook the Tigray regional capital of Mekelle, reviving fears of a renewed and prolonged conflict.
The U.S. Air Force removed all bombers from the RAF Fairford air base in England following an investigation into a suspected terror attack threat.
Tens of thousands of protesters demonstrated across Spain over a deepening housing crisis after emergency legislation failed to pass in parliament.

onThisDay.text: The tragic crash of the British airship R101 en route to India on its maiden voyage marked a major disaster in early aviation history.
Varghese Payyappilly Palakkappilly died, leaving a lasting legacy as an Indian priest who founded the religious congregation Sisters of the Destitute.
The Beatles released their debut single "Love Me Do" in the UK, beginning a revolutionary era in global popular music.
Thousands of Parisian women marched on the Palace of Versailles during the French Revolution, protesting bread scarcity and shifting the balance of power.
